name: gizza-ai/image-split-overlay
summary: Create a static before/after split overlay from two images.

tool.description: Create a static before/after split overlay from exactly two image sources. Image A defines the output canvas; image B is fitted by stretch or cover. orientation chooses vertical, horizontal, diagonal, or diagonal-reverse; position is 0-100 percent; divider_width and divider_color draw the seam; format outputs png or jpeg. Provide images as an ordered list, each a url or a `ref` (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP).

divider_color.description: Divider color as #rgb, #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa. Default white.

divider_width.description: Divider seam width in pixels, 0-400. Use 0 for no divider. Default 4.

fit.description: How image B is fitted to image A's canvas: stretch to exact size, or cover with center-crop. Default stretch.

format.description: Output image format: png (default, preserves alpha) or jpeg.

images.description: Exactly two image sources (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF/BMP): image A first, image B second. Each item has exactly one of `url` or `ref`.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

url.description: URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

orientation.description: Split geometry: vertical (A left/B right), horizontal (A top/B bottom), diagonal (top-left to bottom-right), or diagonal-reverse.

position.description: Split position as a percentage from 0 to 100. Default 50.
